sources.author: René Zandbergen
sources.title: Text Analysis - the Writing System
sources.location: Month names in the zodiac section; later overview MON rows
sources.claim_paraphrase: Lists12 central month annotations, attributes them to a later hand, and favors a northern French reading while acknowledging language debate.

sources.author: Thomas Sauvaget
sources.title: About month names
sources.claim_paraphrase: Proposes northern French variants based on historical comparisons; admits unknown interval between main text and annotations. A2017 author reply allows Swiss/Bavarian possibilities.

sources.claim_paraphrase: Reports that most students regard the central month names as a different hand and ink from the main text. Attempts to equate a nearby Voynich-script item with the month or zodiac sign had not succeeded at that time.
sources.access: Fresh web open failed; pre-existing local cached PDF was rendered and its complete relevant page visually read this turn.

sources.author: Barbara A. Shailor / Yale Beinecke
sources.title: Beinecke MS408 catalog record
sources.claim_paraphrase: Describes concentric zodiac-related diagrams and gives the1978 D’Imperio bibliography. Does not provide a month-annotation reading table or a dated attribution for those notes.
sources.negative_scope: Only this inspected catalog page; not a claim that all Yale holdings lack evidence.
sources.caution: Historical catalog contains older speculative provenance claims; these are not used here.

root_inferences: Central ordinary-letter annotations and surrounding Voynich-script writing must remain separate evidence layers.
A later reader could label recognizable drawings without understanding the encrypted or unknown text; month annotations therefore do not independently identify surrounding words.
The reported table repeats two annotations across paired diagrams; twelve diagram panels are not automatically twelve different month labels.
No precise annotation date, authorship, original-language identity, or one-to-one Voynich word translation was established in this review.
No change to f67r2 scoring eligibility or the frozen geometric object reports follows from this source check.
unresolved: Exact date and scribe of the annotations
